payload.summary: Clinical hazard-control content drift only warns and never fails the governance gate (audit F13)
payload.detail: Verified offline: scripts/check-clinical-hazard-controls.mjs detects reviewedPathDigests drift and console.warns 'This is not a failure'. Warning-only was a deliberate choice after #D7K71C (squash-orphaned reviewedCommit turned CI red). Next action: make safety-semantic drift blocking but allow an explicit reviewed exception with an expiry date, so an intended edit does not red every branch. Do not revert to the reviewedCommit check.
